files..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy to R2

# The PAS deploy pipeline (#427): build, migrations, app worker, tool registration,
# keyless R2 upload, marketing site, QA and E2E all run in the platform's reusable
# workflow. Per-app options are its inputs, e.g.
#   with:
#     e2e: web          # auto | e2e | web | none
#     marketing: false  # auto | true | false
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

# Keyless deploy: the pipeline mints a GitHub OIDC token (no stored secret).
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: proappstore-online/platform/.github/workflows/app-deploy.yml@app-deploy-v1
    secrets: inherit
